The CelcomDigi app has become the one place I go to manage my mobile line. The home screen shows options to view my remaining data, calls and validity as soon as I open it, so I don't have to dial USSD codes or guess how much quota is left. The usage breakdown is clear and easy to read.
 
Buying add-ons is quick. When I need more data, I pick an internet pass, confirm, and it's active within seconds. Before travelling I bought a roaming pass for my destination in the app, and it saved me from bill shock overseas. Checking and paying my bill is also simple: I can see my bill details, download past statements, and set up auto billing so I never miss a due date.
 
I also like the lifestyle passes. Being able to subscribe to streaming bundles directly from the app, and to manage data sharing with my family lines, makes it feel like more than a telco app. The rewards and vouchers section is a nice bonus, and there's usually a deal worth checking.
 
Security feels solid. Biometric login makes getting in fast, and device binding gives me confidence that my account is protected. When I registered a new SIM, the eKYC process with the ID scan and face verification was smooth, and I didn't have to visit a store.
 
The app keeps improving with every update. Overall it's convenient, reliable and well designed. Highly recommended for any CelcomDigi customer.

I use the CelcomDigi app quite regularly and it has been really convenient for managing my lines in one place.
 
The main thing I appreciate is how easy it is to check my bills, outstanding balance and usage. I have a primary line together with supplementary lines, so having everything organised clearly in the same app makes it much easier for me to keep track of each line without having to go elsewhere.
 
I also find myself exploring the app beyond just checking my account. There are quite a lot of things available within it, including other CelcomDigi products, services and current offers.
As an Apple user, I personally enjoy browsing the Tech section as well. It is useful when I want to check out new devices or see what deals are currently available, especially around new Apple launches. It saves me from having to search around separately just to see the latest device offers.
 
If there is one thing I would improve, it would probably be the loading speed. Sometimes the app takes a little longer than I would like to load, although it is still manageable and hasn’t stopped me from using it.
 
I would also love to see more rewards or little freebies for people who regularly open and use the app. Something like that would definitely give me more reason to check in more often.
 
Overall, it has become a useful app for me because I can manage my lines, check my account and explore other offers all in one place.

Been using the CelcomDigi app for a few months already, and honestly, it makes managing my mobile account so much easier lah. The interface is clean now and quite intuitive, so I don't really get lost trying to find things. Checking data usage, topping up, or changing plans, just a few taps only, and everything loads fast, no lag one.

What I like most is how personalized the app feels. My dashboard shows offers based on how I actually use my line, not just random promos. The rewards also quite good, I've redeemed a few vouchers that actually felt worth it, not just "buy 10 get discount 1 cent" type thing.

Since I'm the kind who loves watching all sorts of movies and shows across different platforms, the entertainment add-on section is really the highlight for me. I keep switching between streaming services depending on my mood, so having everything in one app really saves me the hassle. 

Subscribing also very simple — just browse, pick what I want, activate almost instantly, no need jump to another app pulak. And the best part is how easy to cancel or switch. I'm not the type to keep paying for something I'm not watching anymore, so I just pause or cancel in a few taps whenever I feel like taking a break. No need go through long process, and I can see all my active subscriptions in one list, so I always know what I'm paying for, don't get "shock" bill at the end of the month.

Navigation also straightforward, billing, usage, rewards all easy to find. Auto-renewal and reminders also on point, never caught off guard.
Overall, CelcomDigi app really has become my go-to for managing both my telco and streaming needs. Reliable, convenient, and honestly quite satisfying to use. Recommended lah!
